definitions.explanation: The act of paying money, often used as a suffix to indicate a payment method or timing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{月末|げつまつ}→月末：00070_getsumatsu⟧{払|ばら}いです。
examples.english: Salaries are paid at the end of the month.

examples.japanese: {現金|げんきん}{払|ばら}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
⟦{分割|ぶんかつ}→分割：11745_bunkatsu⟧{払|ばら}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

notes:
{払|はら}い (read as ばらい when used as a suffix) indicates a method or timing of payment. Derived from the verb ⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (to pay).

COMPOUNDS:
- {現金|げんきん}{払|ばら}い: cash payment
- カード{払|ばら}い: card payment
- ⟦{分割|ぶんかつ}→分割：11745_bunkatsu⟧{払|ばら}い: installment payment
- {一括|いっかつ}{払|ばら}い: lump-sum payment
- ⟦{月末|げつまつ}→月末：00070_getsumatsu⟧{払|ばら}い: end-of-month payment
- {後|あと}{払|ばら}い: deferred payment
- {前|まえ}{払|ばら}い: advance payment

PRONUNCIATION:
As a standalone noun, read as はらい. As a suffix in compounds, read as ばらい (rendaku/sequential voicing).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {払|はら}い/〜{払|ばら}い: payment (everyday, often suffix)
- {支払|しはら}い: payment (more formal, used in contracts and invoices)
- ⟦{決済|けっさい}→決済：05466_kessai⟧: settlement, payment processing (business/financial term)
